status: CONSOLIDATED, pending owner review before freeze

roots.design_system.doc: Root(s) of the shared design system (primitives, tokens, components).

roots.telemetry.doc: Root of the telemetry tracking plan and signal definitions.

roots.coordination.doc: Root of the durable workflow-coordination records.

roots.conventions.doc: Where the stack's convention documents and convention graph live.

roots.generated.doc: Generated output trees (documentation, renders, views) that are outputs, never authored inputs.

roles.layer_catalog.doc: Per-layer and per-side facts: layer responsibilities, layers per side, layers each harness exercises, component-type catalog and weights.

roles.runtime_components.doc: The plan-executing runtime components (dispatcher, journey/train/interlocking runners, route resolver, train executor): local names, entry points, locations.

roles.plan_hierarchy.doc: Plan decomposition levels, the unit of decomposition and its local names, containment fields.

layout.locations.doc: Location (path segment, glob or pattern) of an artifact kind not covered by a dedicated layout key.

layout.registries.doc: Registry and index files that enumerate artifacts of a kind (decisions, contracts, trains, themes, subjects...).

layout.schemas.doc: Locations of schemas that define artifact formats.

layout.contract_paths.doc: Contract tree layout: root, per-layout schema paths (flat, faceted, collection), catalog and contract-test locations.

urn.test_kinds.doc: Test-identity URN shapes and kind segments per test kind (e2e, train e2e, journey smoke, responsive, telemetry), and harness-code maps.

urn.header.doc: Header fields and markers a file carries for traceability (identity, Tested-By, runtime, journey/train references).

urn.grammar.doc: URN and identifier grammar not covered by a per-artifact key: separators, named parts, identity fields, reference shapes.

urn.builder.doc: Canonical constructs that build a URN for an artifact kind.

idiom.plan_syntax.doc: Constructs of plan artifacts (produce/consume, routes, trains, ownership, status, references, sessions).

idiom.acceptance_schema.doc: The acceptance-artifact schema: precondition fields, trigger shapes, assertion kinds, harness templates and codes, telemetry decision.

idiom.docs_syntax.doc: Documentation constructs: identity, status and lifecycle, relationships, internal references, generated regions, decision-record headers.

idiom.convention_graph.doc: Convention-graph constructs: node id fields, operative fields, anchors, edge endpoints, rule-binding files.

idiom.routing.doc: Composition-root routing constructs: action-to-route maps, route tables, journey maps and registries, start and launch surfaces.

idiom.test_constructs.doc: Test-code constructs: test case and context, assertions and matchers, substitutions, phase and RED markers, fixtures, browser measurements.

idiom.responsive.doc: Responsive styling: breakpoints, viewports, width conditions and declarations, length units, styling contexts and notations.

idiom.design_system.doc: Design-system constructs: token definition and reference, raw colour literals, component exports, barrels, interactive controls, renderers.

idiom.markup.doc: Declarative markup constructs beyond the dedicated idiom keys: request and swap constructs, progress signals, event handlers, ids, interpolation.

idiom.telemetry.doc: Telemetry constructs: emit calls, event shapes, vendor SDKs, observation tiers and channels.

idiom.logging.doc: Logging constructs: logger receivers, structured logger, context shape, ad-hoc print calls, CLI output.

idiom.security.doc: Security-relevant constructs: SQL sinks and parameterisation, authorization checks, environment access, error-response payloads.

idiom.module_boundaries.doc: Module and runtime boundary constructs: imports, outbound I/O calls, servers, collaborators, composition domains, structural roots.

idiom.dto_shape.doc: How a DTO is declared, named and kept pure.

idiom.naming.doc: Naming constructs: verb lexicon, name-token separators.

idiom.source_syntax.doc: Source-syntax facts used by checks: comment-line kinds, complexity measure, runtime-declaration header and values.

idiom.collaboration.doc: Collaboration-toolchain idioms: seat addresses, integration branches, delegation context, model portfolio, file-reading tool.

enforcement.exceptions.doc: Where and how intentional exceptions are declared (allow-lists, coverage exceptions, naming exceptions).

enforcement.presets.doc: Profile presets per kind of work and the location of each profile's registry.

tooling.commands.doc: Helper commands of the stack's toolchain (authoring, plan session, generators, renderers, seat lifecycle, cleanup).

tooling.language_scopes.doc: Languages per check scope (scanned code, test files, in-scope files).

tooling.test_harness.doc: The declared test harness, foreign harnesses that must not be used, and runtime families of tests.

tooling.typecheck.doc: Typecheck configuration, checker dependencies, no-emit commands, step names and strictness options.

tooling.stack_signals.doc: Markers by which a repository or package is recognised as this stack.

tooling.appendix_formats.doc: Appendix types, their file formats, and which formats the agent tooling can read.
